page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top right. Faint marks in the right margin and at the left edge are show-through or edge marks and are not transcribed. Nothing printed under the text except a faint, undecipherable line at the foot.

main_text.p: certam definiebant, quas utrasque idem Plato in νομοφυλάκων[?] suam transcripsit. Fuit & illa memorabilis à Platone etiam celebrata, quâ juvenibus inquirere in leges patrias, benè aut secùs habeant, interdictum: præceptum verò, ut non nisi honorificè, tanquam quæ sanctæ ac venerabiles sint, de iis sententiam loquanturque: senibus verò permissum, si quid ipsis succurreret, quod huc pertineret, ut id submotis juvenibus ad magistratus, & ætate æquales referrent. Quo modo legislator legum majestati consulere voluit. Atque his legibus quamdiu Cretenses paruère, ait Strabo, cui maternum genus è Creta erat, satis feliciter egerunt. Verùm prolapsa sensim legum observatione, mo-res etiam cum fortunâ in deterius ivère.

Inclinationis hujus principium ex æmulatione ortum, cum majores insu-læ urbes Cnossus, Cydon, Gortyn, Lyctus diffidentes inter se ad augendum potentiam suam arma civilia in sese verterent. Hac enim ratione vires universorum, quæ stante concordiâ haud parvæ fuerant, imminutæ. Deinde piratarum Cilicum commercio Cretenses impli-[?]

page.notes: Faint marks in the right margin (q, nn, m, ıo and similar) look like show-through from the reverse and were not transcribed. The Greek word on the first line is read as νομοφυλάκων and is doubtful. The last line is partly obscured by show-through; "impli-" is read with its hyphen, and the rest is not legible. The word "Lyctus" is split across lines without a printed hyphen. The large initial reads as I. The bottom of the page has a faint, illegible line that is likely show-through.
